# SEO Ecommerce

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): e-commerce SEO analysis of product pages and Product schema, plus a UCP profile audit, all workable without any key through the family's page tools (outside this folder). Its Google Shopping, Amazon and keyword-gap branches require the paid DataForSEO Merchant API (user's own credits, mandatory cost check before every call, Amazon always with user approval). Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
